notes.title: Hello exterminators!!!
notes.content:
Hello dear exterminators!

I hadn't gotten my hands on this title for many, many years, so I decided to try to update its [b]engine[/b] or bring it to the version of Unity that I use for the most recent games.

While looking for the file of the latest published version of Bugs, I realized that I don't have the one updated to 1.002 anymore. Therefore, before publishing an obsolete version, I decided to see if, after so many years, there was still any interest in this title.
If so, I'll take it back, fix the issues already fixed in 1.001 and 1.002, and release 1.003.


I'm updating all my games, both new and older, so please check them out:
[b]Cursor Challenge
Home Wars
Multicellular
Age of Undead
Gummy Dummy Battles[/b]

notes.title: Update to version 1.002
notes.content:
Hello friends!
How are you? Here, in Italy, it's very very hot ... definitely too hot.


Here is the news:

- we've solved a problem with the navigation of the inhabitants in the houses.

- we've increased the blast range of the standard bombs and impact bombs.

- the insecticides now work better.

- some textures of the furniture have been changed.


If you find some issue with the game, please contact us.

... just one last thing: kill all those m**********s!

notes.title: Update to version 1.001
notes.content:
Hello guys!
We are happy you're enjoying the game <3


We fixed a few errors that you pointed out:

- Solved the problem at the campaign's beginning in the second map.  

- Solved the bug of the money "update" in the new turn.

- Corrected some typing errors.


If you notice some problems or you have some good suggestions, let us know using our email or Community Hub ...
... and see you at the next update! ;)
